values.note: Back-in and pull-through sites $35 per unit per day, full-hookup sites $40 (4 people per site at most); tent sites $25 per tent. Cancelling forfeits one night. Rates from the operator's current site, which announces the 2026 season's last day.

fees.source: https://www.prhcamp.com/back-in-and-tent-sites.html ('Back in sites are $35 per unit/per day', 'Tent sites are $25 per tent/per day') + pull-through-sites.html ('Pull through site occupancy rates are $35 per unit per day') + fhu-sites.html ('Full hookup site occupancy rates are $40 per unit per day'; 'Cancelled reservations will forefit the cost associated with one (1) night') + home page ('Our last day of business for the 2026 season will be Friday October 23'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The operator announced Friday October 23 as the 2026 season's last day; no opening date is posted (the stored May 15 opening is from note prose).

season.source: https://www.prhcamp.com/ ('Our last day of business for the 2026 season will be Friday October 23'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.prhcamp.com/fhu-sites.html ('The full hookup sites ... All four of them have 50 amp electric service. Water pressure is high so we recommend a pressure reduction valve'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 10 pull-through sites (4 of them full hookup, across the road from the service building; 6 behind it) and 18 RV/tent sites; 5 insulated sleeping cabins. No tents on pull-through or full-hookup sites. 'Big rig friendly'.

sites.source: https://www.prhcamp.com/ ('5 fully insulated sleeping cabins, 10 pull through sites (4 FHU), and 18 RV/tent sites with Wi-Fi access'; 'We are big rig friendly!') + pull-through-sites.html ('There are 6 pull through sites located behind the service building'), read 2026-10-22. The stored 32 sites and 65-ft maximum came from note prose; the operator gives 28 sites and no length, so the length is cleared.

facilities.source: https://www.prhcamp.com/ ('a clean modern shower building', 'Our service building features clean restrooms with in-floor heat', 'RV/tent sites with Wi-Fi access') + pull-through-sites.html ('The dump station and dumpster are located on the right as you exit the campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book online (GraceSoft EasyWebRez) or by phone; all reservations require advance payment. Register at the office on arrival; check-in 2-7:30pm (call ahead if later), check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.prhcamp.com/ ('Click Here to Book Online' -> apps.gracesoft.com/PMS/EasyWebRez/roomdetails/4679; 'All reservations require advance payment'; 'Check In is between 2:00 PM & 7:30 PM') + GraceSoft page (room types BACK IN, FHU SITES, PULL THROUGH SITES, TENT, CABIN), read 2026-10-22

note: Private campground on 24 acres of bluffs above the Paint River in downtown Crystal Falls (use '220 Railway St.' for directions), with direct access to the state and county ATV trails. A half-mile hiking loop runs along the river past calcite outcrops and old cedars, with tree markers in Ojibwa; no boat access to the river from the campground. --Claude
summary: Operator site is live and current (http now redirects to https; 2026 season notice). Confirmed 50-amp full hookups, pull-throughs, showers/Wi-Fi/dump, phone 906-875-4977. Added fees $35 (back-in/pull-through) to $40 (full hookup), online booking on GraceSoft, flush toilets. Changed season close 11-30 -> 10-23 (operator's 2026 last day) and sites 32 -> 28; cleared derived 65-ft max (operator says only 'big rig friendly'). Note rewritten: the old 'reserve by phone; reported cash-only' and 'HTTP-only' are out of date.
flags: Website: http://www.prhcamp.com now redirects to https://www.prhcamp.com/ (live, current, with a GraceSoft booking engine); the entry can take the https URL. The old note's 'Official site is HTTP-only' and 'reserve by phone; reported cash-only' are out of date.
Price under US$50 ($35 base). No gateway within 40 km (nearest Isle Royale NP 115 km); the family has not stayed here. Presence met (live site, phone, booking engine).
